issues: On Super-Evolve is incorrectly encoded as searchDeckChoose with no way to take up to 2 cards; it should allow revealing and adding up to 2 Natura cards from the top 4 to hand, then put the rest on the bottom.

Fanfare filter is incorrect: tutorFromCemetery uses filter.keyword, but DeckFilter does not support keyword and the card specifically wants a follower with [evolve] in your cemetery; encode this with an implemented card-identifying filter if possible, otherwise add DeckFilter support for printed keyword/evolve-line matching.

The trigger condition is too broad: onAllyEvolve means only ally followers evolve, but the source says whenever a follower on your field evolves, so it should trigger from any follower on your field, including this one; add an implemented timing/condition for 'when a follower on your field evolves' or a self-inclusive ally-evolve trigger.
Spell effect is incomplete and untargeted: summonSameNameToken should target a Supreme token follower on your field that costs 5 or less, not summon from source without selection.
evolvesTo is incorrect; it should link to the evolved form card name, not to the base card name.

Fanfare filter is too broad: grantNextPlayCostReduction is set to any Dragoncraft card, but it should apply only to the next Draconic Duelist card you play this turn, so filter by trait 'Draconic Duelist' instead.
